services.desc: If you want to get fit fast, but you’re sick of the flash-in-the-pan fad workouts that leave you bored halfway through the first class, you need to discover kickboxing classes at the Defensive Arts Training Centre in St. Catharines. You’ll get an amazing workout and you’ll have a blast class after class. What’s more, you’ll be learning one of the very best self-defence methods ever created! Kickboxing classes at the Defensive Arts Training Centre were custom designed by Sensei Gerry DiSanto to bring together the best of the best moves from a wide range of martial arts styles including Muay Thai, Karate, Tae Kwon Do, Jiu-jitsu and more.
